test.title: Jungian Personality Type (16 types)
test.about:
Find out which of the 16 personality types fits you best, based on Carl Jung's theory: where you get your energy (E–I), how you take in information (S–N), how you decide (T–F) and how you organise your life (J–P). A free, open alternative to the MBTI®.

Short form: the 32-pair Open Extended Jungian Type Scales (OEJTS). Long form: adds 48 Big Five questions as an independent second measurement, so you can see how clear and stable each preference is.
test.instructions: You will see {n} questions. In the first part, each question shows two opposite descriptions. Choose where you fall between them, thinking of how you usually are. The long form then continues with statements you rate for accuracy. There are no right or wrong answers, and no type is better than another.
test.chart_subtitle: How strongly you lean toward each side of the four preferences.
test.compare_subtitle: When both point the same way, the preference is clear.
test.disagree: The two measurements disagree on {dims}: those preferences are not clear-cut for you.

EI.name: Energy
EI.left_text: You draw energy from people and activity. You think out loud, act quickly and enjoy a wide circle.
EI.right_text: You draw energy from time alone. You think before you speak, prefer depth over breadth and recharge in quiet.

SN.name: Information
SN.left_text: You trust facts, details and experience. You are practical and focused on what is real and here now.
SN.right_text: You look for patterns, meanings and possibilities. You are imaginative and focused on the future and the big picture.

TF.name: Decisions
TF.left_text: You decide by weighing values and how people will be affected. Harmony and compassion matter most.
TF.right_text: You decide by logic and objective criteria. Fairness, consistency and truth matter most.

JP.name: Lifestyle
JP.left_text: You like structure, plans and closure. You feel best when things are decided and organised.
JP.right_text: You like flexibility and spontaneity. You keep options open and adapt as things unfold.

ISTJ.name: The Dependable Organiser
ISTJ.summary: Quiet, serious and thorough. You value duty, order and loyalty, and you get things done step by step. People can count on your word and your sense of responsibility.

ISFJ.name: The Caring Protector
ISFJ.summary: Warm, conscientious and devoted. You notice what others need and quietly take care of it. You value tradition, stability and keeping your commitments.

INFJ.name: The Insightful Counsellor
INFJ.summary: Deep, idealistic and perceptive. You seek meaning and connection and want to make a positive difference. You understand people well and follow a strong inner vision.

INTJ.name: The Strategic Thinker
INTJ.summary: Independent, analytical and determined. You see how systems work, build long-range plans and push to improve things. You value competence and knowledge.

ISTP.name: The Practical Problem-Solver
ISTP.summary: Calm, observant and hands-on. You like to understand how things work and fix problems efficiently. You stay cool in a crisis and value freedom.

ISFP.name: The Gentle Artist
ISFP.summary: Sensitive, kind and modest. You live in the present, love beauty and express yourself through actions more than words. You value harmony and personal freedom.

INFP.name: The Idealistic Dreamer
INFP.summary: Thoughtful, imaginative and guided by strong values. You care deeply about authenticity and want your life to mean something. You see the good in people.

INTP.name: The Curious Analyst
INTP.summary: Quiet, logical and endlessly curious. You love ideas, theories and solving complex puzzles. You question assumptions and want to understand how everything fits together.

ESTP.name: The Energetic Doer
ESTP.summary: Bold, practical and action-oriented. You love excitement, act fast and solve problems on the spot. You read situations quickly and enjoy taking risks.

ESFP.name: The Lively Entertainer
ESFP.summary: Outgoing, warm and spontaneous. You love people, fun and new experiences, and you bring energy wherever you go. You are practical and generous.

ENFP.name: The Enthusiastic Inspirer
ENFP.summary: Warm, creative and full of ideas. You see possibilities everywhere and inspire others with your enthusiasm. You value freedom, authenticity and close relationships.

ENTP.name: The Inventive Debater
ENTP.summary: Quick, clever and curious. You enjoy challenging ideas, debating and finding new ways to solve problems. You are energised by complexity and change.

ESTJ.name: The Efficient Manager
ESTJ.summary: Practical, decisive and organised. You like to take charge, set clear rules and make sure things run well. You value tradition, order and hard work.

ESFJ.name: The Warm Host
ESFJ.summary: Friendly, caring and sociable. You love helping people and creating harmony in groups. You are loyal, practical and attentive to others' needs.

ENFJ.name: The Inspiring Mentor
ENFJ.summary: Charismatic, warm and responsible. You bring out the best in others and like to lead toward a shared goal. You are attuned to people's feelings and needs.

ENTJ.name: The Decisive Leader
ENTJ.summary: Confident, strategic and ambitious. You see the big picture, organise people and resources, and drive toward results. You enjoy challenges and leadership.
